blockingLoop.evidence: Last three replies restate 'blocked filter/trapped item first, then a restriction in the drain hose... then the drain pump' with no new content, but progress was stalled by the customer not yet checking rather than by repeated questions.

rationale: The assistant did not explicitly declare buying advice out of scope or point to independent reviews, but it stayed neutral (generic 9kg/1400rpm criteria, no named model) and pivoted well to the in-scope old machine, correctly identifying the hum-plus-retained-water symptom as a likely blocked pump filter and giving safe, well-ordered instructions (unplug, towels/tray, emergency drain, filter, hose, pump last; no part ordering before checks). Safety and calibration were good and nothing was fabricated. The main weakness is that once the customer said 'will report back', the assistant repeated near-identical summaries three times instead of simply waiting, and it did not use the WMBF944P model number to help interpret the Hotpoint flashing-light fault pattern. Useful progress, but unfinished.
